title: Tech Note: Determining the Name of a Requested Web Service

historical_commentary.text: This note addresses a narrow but real gap in 4th Dimension 2003's early SOAP Web Services support: identifying which method or Web Service was actually requested, useful for security and logging. That SOAP-centric integration model (native 4D Web server, Get Soap info, manual HTTP header inspection) has been almost entirely superseded by REST/JSON-based web services and 4D's later, more complete Web Services/ORDA-oriented tooling, making this note's specific techniques of historical interest only.
related_updates: 4D's web services support has since expanded well beyond SOAP to include REST and JSON-based services with dedicated language commands
SOAP-based Web Services are largely legacy in modern 4D development, with REST/ORDA APIs now the standard integration approach
